name: atlassian-confluence-cloud

description: Atlassian Confluence is a collaborative workspace where teams create, organize, and share project documents, ideas, and knowledge in one central place.

operations.title: Create Footer Comment
operations.description:
Create a footer comment. The footer comment can be made against several locations:

at the top level (specifying pageId or blogPostId in the request body)
as a reply (specifying parentCommentId in the request body)
against an attachment (note: this is different than the comments added via the attachment properties page on the UI, which are referred to as version comments)
against a custom content
